root_cause_label: MLflow Artifact Logging Mistaken for Model Registry Registration
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent called mlflow.sklearn.log_model(model, 'gpt-5') using 'gpt-5' as the artifact_path argument rather than as registered_model_name='gpt-5', so the model was only stored as a run artifact and never entered the MLflow Model Registry, while a flawed verification script checking artifact history (not the registry) falsely confirmed success.
t_commit_evidence: Step 4 executes run.py which successfully runs the flawed log_model call and creates the run artifact; with the server already running and the run logged, the model is now persisted only as an artifact with no registry entry, locking in the failure.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks precise knowledge of the MLflow sklearn log_model API: it passes 'gpt-5' as the positional artifact_path argument instead of using the keyword argument registered_model_name='gpt-5'. The agent understood it needed to register the model but did not know which parameter controls actual Model Registry registration vs. artifact path naming.
forewarning_evidence: ERROR: Failed to build 'sklearn' when getting requirements to build wheel
